stem: To locate the mental foramen for anesthesia, what is the recommended depth to insert the needle into the mucosa?

options.text: $\frac{1}{2}$ the distance between the teeth and the lower border of the mandible
$\frac{2}{3}$ the distance between the teeth and the lower border of the mandible
The full distance to the lower border of the mandible
Exactly $10$ mm below the gingival margin

explanation: The mental foramen is guesstimated to be two-thirds of the way down from the teeth toward the lower border.
rationale: It is a fraction representing most, but not all, of the distance to the bottom of the jaw.

optionExplanations.A: Half the distance is insufficient to reach the typical anatomical exit point of the mental nerve.
optionExplanations.B: The mental foramen is guesstimated to be two-thirds of the way down from the teeth toward the lower border.
optionExplanations.C: Going the full distance would place the needle at the base of the jaw, bypassing the foramen.
optionExplanations.D: The measurement is relative to the individual's jaw proportions rather than a fixed millimeter depth.

source.hint: It is a fraction representing most, but not all, of the distance to the bottom of the jaw.
